title: Search ranks the sender and subject above text-only matches
steps: Pick a sender whose display name has two words, from the inbox
Press /, type those two words (no from:), press Return
Look at the first rows, then scroll further down
expected: Conversations from that sender come first, even old ones; newer mail that only mentions the words in its text follows below them, so nothing is hidden. No date headers (Today, Last 7 days, a month) appear among the results while they are sorted by relevance.
